name: Tam, the Possibility Gorgon
description: A gorgon created by Jace Beleren, his spy and agent, who is figuring out who she is and beginning to doubt his methods after meeting Strixhaven students.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jace creates Tam, who becomes his spy and agent to gather the final pieces for the new reality.
timeline.quote: Created by Jace Beleren, Tam has dutifully followed and learned from her teacher.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
